title: When AI Begins to Build Itself: An Academic and Didactic Analysis of When AI Builds Itself
description: This independent bilingual report analyzes the Anthropic Institute article When AI Builds Itself. It distinguishes AI-accelerated research and development from full recursive self-improvement, evaluates the evidence and methodological limitations, and discusses implications for scientific practice, organizational design, human expertise, AI safety, and governance. Complete English and Portuguese editions are included.
